question: **Which of the following things did people in ancient India use for body and hair wash?**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Shikakai**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The last sentence of the second paragraph in the given passage states, *"**Ancient India also used shikai or shikakai (a variant of the acacia plant) as a hair and body cleanser.__"*
 
• From here we can say that in ancient India people used Shikakai for body and hair washing.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
